exposure: Clinical screener of anxiety severity/impairment (OASIS) in first and third trimester
Two instruments measuring pregnancy anxiety (PSAS) in first and third trimester
One instrument on prenatal distress in first and third trimester
cohort: The study participants were 196 women interviewed during their first and third trimesters of pregnancy.
finding: The latent factor for third-trimester pregnancy anxiety significantly predicted shorter gestational length, even after adjusting for maternal age, education, parity, and obstetric risk.
